3c5298bd36.substituent_description: A central benzene ring (drawn with an aromatic circle) carries, para to each other, a 5-membered two-nitrogen ring (attached through a ring carbon; its other ring N bears Me) and an N-H group; an OEt group sits on the ring carbon next to the NH-bearing carbon (meta to the five-membered ring). The NH is drawn bonded to an N atom of a fused bicyclic 6-6 system (one ring N at the fusion-adjacent corner, one ring with a C=N and a methyl line); that bicycle also bears, on the carbon next to its ring N, an N atom that is part of a 5-membered ring with an OMe on one ring carbon and unlabeled lines (methyls) on the adjacent carbon.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Top right N-containing ring: five-membered ring containing N, with a MeO on one carbon and two unlabeled line stubs (methyls) on a neighbouring carbon, with lines crossing at that carbon
The bond between the NH and the bicyclic ring N reads as an N-N bond
Bicycle: double bonds drawn inconsistently (one ring has three inner lines, the other only one), short stub inside a ring
Unlabeled line ends (methyl groups) on bicycle and on the five-membered ring
3c5298bd36.notes: Handwritten, black ink on white paper, very freehand. Double-bond count: 2 in the two-N five-membered ring, 3 in the upper bicycle ring (including a short vertical stub), 1 in the lower bicycle ring.

8fd667f569.substituent_description: Left ring is drawn with five vertices and three inner double-bond lines; the NH is on one ring carbon, F on the adjacent carbon (ortho) and a second F on the next carbon (meta to the NH), i.e. 2,3-difluoro relative to NH. NH-C(=O)-CH(hashed unlabeled methyl)-O-C(=O)-CH2CH2-N, where the N is the nitrogen of a six-membered ring fused to a benzene ring (N, C(=O), CH2, O, and two aromatic carbons: a benzoxazinone).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Left ring is drawn with only five vertices yet has three inner double-bond lines (looks like a benzene with a missing vertex)
Hashed bond goes to an unlabeled terminal end (methyl) on the stereocentre carbon
8fd667f569.notes: Handwritten. Double bonds: 3 in left five-membered ring, 3 C=O (amide, ester, lactam), 3 in the benzo ring. H is written above N in the left amide label.

6f62db5183.substituent_description: Long unbranched alkyl zigzag chain starting at Et on the left and ending at an amide NH-C(=O) attached to a para-disubstituted benzene ring; the other para position carries a CH2CH2 linker to C4 of a piperidine. The piperidine N is acylated as a urea N-C(=O)-NH attached to a second para-disubstituted benzene whose para position carries N(Me)2.
6f62db5183.notes: Typeset structure. Exact number of chain carbons between Et and the amide NH not counted with confidence (roughly ten). Double bonds: 3 in each benzene ring plus 2 C=O.

a3700ffaac.substituent_description: A carbazole whose ring N carries Et and whose 3-position carries a CH2 linked to the N of a piperidine; the piperidine C4 is the spiro carbon of an indane (benzo-fused five-membered ring). In the indane ring, the carbon next to the spiro carbon carries OH on a solid wedge, and the next carbon (attached to the benzo ring) carries NHAc on a hashed bond.
a3700ffaac.notes: Typeset structure. Double bonds: 3 in each of the two carbazole benzene rings and 3 in the indane benzene ring.

a6e343fa47.substituent_description: A peptide-like chain: H2N-C(=O)-NH-CH2CH2-CH(bold wedge to NH)-... and an iPr (bold wedge) / NHBoc substituted alpha carbon with a C(=O) bonded to that NH; the NH is then bonded to CH2-C(=O)-HN attached to a benzene ring (aromatic circle). On that ring the HN is on one carbon, a CH2OH on the carbon para to it, and a CH2-N(Me)-C(=O)-O-CH2 on the carbon adjacent to the CH2OH carbon (meta to the HN); the CH2 ends at a fluorene (9-fluorenyl) group with two aromatic-circle benzene rings and a five-membered ring.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Exact ring positions of CH2OH and CH2N(Me) relative to the HN on the middle benzene ring are hard to be certain of
The upper bold wedge sits between the chain carbon and the NH nitrogen; its narrow end and the stereocentre it belongs to are unclear
H of the NH is written below N; NHBoc written as one label
a6e343fa47.notes: Handwritten, black ink on white. Double bonds: 4 C=O (urea, two amides, carbamate).

03e4153f2b.substituent_description: A quinoline (benzene fused to a pyridine ring with N, drawn with alternating double bonds): the carbon next to the ring N carries an NH linked to a phenyl ring (aromatic circle) that bears CH3 on the carbon ortho to the NH-bearing carbon; the next ring carbon (position 3 of the quinoline) carries C(=O)NH-CH2- bonded to a second phenyl ring (aromatic circle, unsubstituted).
03e4153f2b.notes: Handwritten in graphite/pencil (dark grey, treated as black). Double bonds: 5 in the quinoline plus 1 C=O. N and H of the left NH are stacked vertically (H below N).

104a6a00af.substituent_description: A piperidine with EtO on C4 (solid wedge), an aryl group on C2 (hashed bond) and CH2-indol-4-yl on N1. The aryl ring has the piperidine on one carbon, an O-CH2CH2-NHAc group on the adjacent carbon (ortho) and HO2C on the carbon para to the piperidine attachment. The indole (NH) has the CH2 on C4, MeO on C5, and an unlabeled methyl line on C7.
104a6a00af.notes: Typeset structure. Double bonds: 3 in the aryl ring, 3 in the indole benzo ring and 1 in the indole five-membered ring.

fc0fe786ea.substituent_description: A benzene ring (aromatic circle) bears C(=O)OEt on one carbon and, para to it, a CH=C(unlabeled methyl line)- double-bonded vinyl linker leading to a second aromatic-circle benzene ring. That second ring is fused to a saturated six-membered ring carrying two pairs of unlabeled line stubs (gem-dimethyl groups) on the two carbons flanking the ring; the vinyl linker is attached to the aromatic carbon adjacent to a ring-fusion carbon.
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Carbonyl carbon is drawn as a loop/curl rather than a clean vertex
Unlabeled line ends (methyl groups) with small hook/arrow-like ticks at the ends of some
Exact attachment position of the vinyl linker on the fused aromatic ring is hard to judge
fc0fe786ea.notes: Handwritten, black ink, rough. Double bonds: 1 C=O and 1 C=C (alkene).

e5490087e7.substituent_description: Left benzene ring (aromatic circle) has a CH2 on one carbon, F on the adjacent carbon and Cl on the next carbon (2-fluoro-3-chlorobenzyl); the CH2 goes to NH-C(=O)-CH2-N(iPr)-C(=O)-CH2- attached to the N of an indole. The indole has Ac on C3 (pyrrole C2=C3 double bond drawn) and its benzo ring (aromatic circle) carries CH2-C(=O)- on a carbon of the benzo ring (position 5), whose C(=O) is bonded to the N of a six-membered ring (piperidine) bearing two F on the carbon beta to N (3,3-difluoro).
overlaps_or_ambiguities: Cl label is cursive and small
Position of the CH2C(=O) substituent on the indole benzo ring is hard to confirm
e5490087e7.notes: Handwritten, black ink. Double bonds: 3 C=O and 1 C=C in the pyrrole ring; benzene rings drawn with aromatic circles.
